producerAndOrdering.entry: ServiceOverrideAnalyzer.Initialize lines22-26 disables generated-code analysis, enables concurrent execution, and registers AnalyzeInvocation for InvocationExpression.
realSymbolProducer: Syntactic method-name fast path must be ConfigureServices.
SemanticModel.GetSymbolInfo(invocation, cancellationToken).Symbol must be IMethodSymbol, whose name and containing type identify ServerStartOptions.ConfigureServices.
Calls within ServerStartOptions are skipped, avoiding its generic-to-nongeneric forwarding body.
Generic overload uses its one actual method type argument; non-generic two-parameter overload requires a typeof expression to obtain the override type through GetTypeInfo.
GetConstantValue on the method-name expression must produce a string before any GetMembers lookup.
producerAndOrdering.candidateProducer: overrideType.GetMembers(methodName) returns ImmutableArray<ISymbol> for that name (LSP API contract), then OfType<IMethodSymbol>, exactly one parameter, then parameter Type.ToDisplayString equal to Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IServiceCollection, then ToList.
evaluationOrder: ToList exhausts the filtered source before any Count/static check.
Count==0 reports E2E001 on invocation.GetLocation and returns.
Nonempty list is scanned with FirstOrDefault(m => m.IsStatic) in retained source enumeration order.
No static candidate reports E2E003 on invocation.GetLocation.
A static candidate causes no diagnostic; the selected symbol is used only for the null check, not emitted or invoked by this analyzer.
producerAndOrdering.diagnosticPrecedenceWithinInvocation: Nonconstant E2E002 precedes member production; E2E001 distinguishes no signature-matching method from E2E003 for signature-matching methods but no static match.
producerAndOrdering.globalDiagnosticOrdering: Not claimed; concurrent analyzer execution is enabled.
producerAndOrdering.enumerationCaution: The initial named-member result is an ImmutableArray, but GetMembers lookup, Roslyn symbol access, OfType/Where and ToDisplayString are not assumed free. Current code evaluates the filter once and scans the materialized list for static membership. Re-enumerating a deferred filter can repeat work; a lone static FirstOrDefault conflates the two error states.

generatorAndConsumer.independentGenerator: StartupHookGenerator is an IIncrementalGenerator. Initialize uses CreateSyntaxProvider(IsConfigureServicesCandidate, ExtractCallsite), filters nulls, Collects and registers EmitServiceOverrideResolver.
generatorAndConsumer.separateLookup: ExtractCallsite lines139-147 performs its own GetMembers/OfType/FirstOrDefault with IsStatic before parameter checks. It does not consume the analyzer candidates list or targetMethod.
generatorAndConsumer.generatedResultContract: Invalid/nonconstant callsites return null. Valid callsites produce type/assembly/method-name metadata; EmitServiceOverrideResolver emits ServiceOverrideResolver.g.cs with direct method-group delegate arms. This is source behavior, not an observed generated output.
runtimeSourcePath: ServerStartOptions.ConfigureServices stores the type assembly-qualified name and method name; generic overload forwards to that method.
ServerInstance.BuildProcessEnvironment transports E2E_TEST_SERVICES_TYPE and E2E_TEST_SERVICES_METHOD for the managed startup-hook path.
TestReadinessHostingStartup attempts the generated IE2EServiceOverrideResolver and falls back to reflection when unresolved.
TestServiceOverrideObserver invokes the resulting configure-services action at the host-building service-configuration boundary.
